## Summary

Records the August WG direction as an Agent Behavior Trace Model execution plan. The nine linked issues are the plan of record, covering the shared relationship contract, two agent examples, provider API examples, reusable tests, and evidence-backed upstream contributions.

## Related Issue

Closes #39. Execution tasks: #40, #41, #42, #43, #44, #45, #46, #47.

Related recommendation work in #12 and #19 remains separate and unchanged.

## Review Notes

Check that the task breakdown accurately records the August direction. This is not a new request to agree on initial scope. Detailed relationship semantics are developed in #41.

## Follow-ups

Select the second agent/SDK and initial provider pair, and find contributors and reviewers for the implementation tasks. Those tasks remain open after this plan merges.
